source_origin: Original JavaScript implementation created for this packet from the standard LeetCode problem specification; uncertain premium contracts were cross-checked against LeetCode/LeetCode Wiki. No external solution implementation was copied. Gamma assignment-packet provenance and contract verification remain pending.
normalization: Defines the standard LeetCode entry signature `function calculateMinimumHP(dungeon)` as a self-contained synchronous function. No Gamma-specific wrapper or multi-parameter normalization was applied.
numeric_semantics: Uses JavaScript Number integer arithmetic and Infinity only as an internal unreachable sentinel; standard sums are exactly representable.
mutation_contract: Does not mutate dungeon; uses a separate one-row dynamic-programming array.
interface_support: Supports a nonempty rectangular numeric matrix and returns the minimum initial health synchronously.
input_domain: Finite nonempty rectangular matrices of integer health gains and losses.
